cultural_cooperation.name: Cultural cooperation
cultural_cooperation.description: Exchanges, exhibitions and a year of easier talk between two capitals.

research_cooperation.name: Research cooperation
research_cooperation.description: Laboratories that share results for a year.

military_attache.name: Military attaché
military_attache.description: An officer at the other capital, and a staff that recovers a little faster for it.

consular_convention.name: Consular convention
consular_convention.description: Consulates that keep trade moving without a full commercial treaty.

student_exchange.name: Student exchange
student_exchange.description: A year of students in each other's universities.

intelligence_sharing.name: Shared intelligence
intelligence_sharing.description: A year in which each staff sees a little of what the other has already learned.

border_commission.name: Border commission
border_commission.description: A commission that keeps the border a place of rules rather than incidents.

technology_licence.name: Licensed technology
technology_licence.description: A paid licence, not a gift: the buyer's laboratories move a little faster for a year.

airspace_cooperation.name: Airspace cooperation
airspace_cooperation.description: Corridors and warning shared for a year. It is not an alliance.
